statement: The function returns a result r (it does not fail), and r is the maximum, over all perfect pairings P of the index set {0,1,...,len(nums)-1}, of the sum over {i,j} in P of min(nums[i], nums[j]). A perfect pairing is a set of n unordered pairs {i,j} with i < j such that every index in {0,...,len(nums)-1} occurs in exactly one pair.
preconditions: Let n = len(nums)/2. We require 1 <= n <= 10000, len(nums) = 2*n, and -10000 <= nums[i] <= 10000 for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums).
